decided: LST-6 (#7488), per the epic's named bounded set (#7481): evidence's one-row-per-environment roll-up
decision: The Evidence posture table is a roll-up, not a log: one row per environment the reader may view, grouped by project and sorted worst-first across the WHOLE set (lib/rpc/procedures/evidence.ts → deriveGroups), and its status facet counts and posture counters are computed over that same set. A page of it would cut the triage order and show a 'worst' that is only the worst of page one, so it stays unpaged on purpose. Its filter surface (useEvidenceFilters) therefore never pages through useKeysetList. The recorded-waivers panel under it IS a log and is keyset-paged (evidence.waivers → queryEvidenceWaiversPage, useKeysetList + ListFooter).
bound: The roll-up's rows are the environments of the org's projects the reader may view (lib/queries/evidence.ts → queryOrgEvidence selects project_environments joined to projects with projects.org_id = the org and projects.id in the reader's viewable set), so its size is the org's environment count. The in-force waivers it reads beside them are bounded by expiry, not by a cap; the full waiver log is paged.
